headline: GOLD HOLDS $4,052 AND SILVER SNAPS BACK TO $60 AS JUNE NFP LANDS TODAY — THIN PRE-HOLIDAY TAPE COULD AMPLIFY ANY SURPRISE
snippet: Gold spot held near US$4,052 and silver rebounded to US$60.07 (+1.67%) in early July 2 trade as markets awaited June Non-Farm Payrolls at 8:30 AM ET — the most pivotal data release of the week given that rate-hike expectations for September now sit above 60% following Tuesday's stronger-than-expected JOLTS print. With U.S. markets closing early for Independence Day and trading volumes already thinning, even a modest NFP miss or beat could produce outsized moves: a soft print (sub-100K) would drive gold back toward the $4,100 Warsh-pivot highs from July 1, while a beat above 140K would likely accelerate selling toward the $3,900–$3,850 structural support zone that StoneX's Rhona O'Connell identified as the potential seasonal trough. Silver's bounce off seven-session lows was supported by industrial demand expectations and a slightly softer dollar overnight.

headline: FIREFLY GREEN BAY PRINTS THICK HIGH-GRADE VMS CORE — 42m @ 6.1% CuEq AND 51.5m @ 4.9% CuEq; PEA DUE JULY-AUGUST (ASX:FFM / TSX:FFM)
snippet: Firefly Metals Ltd. (ASX:FFM / TSX:FFM) released July 1, 2026 drill results from the Green Bay Copper-Gold Project in Newfoundland that confirmed a thick high-grade VMS core: highlight intersections include 42 metres at 6.1% copper equivalent and 51.5 metres at 4.9% copper equivalent from the Ming deposit — grades that rank among the best reported from any VMS system in Canada in recent years. The results advance an already substantial resource base at a project with permitted and operational infrastructure, with a Preliminary Economic Assessment scheduled for release in July or August 2026 expected to define project economics for the first time at current metal prices. Firefly has been one of the more closely watched copper-gold developers on the TSX since its acquisition of the historic Green Bay assets, and the new drill core data significantly de-risks the PEA ahead of its release.

headline: ARAFURA'S ALL-OR-NOTHING VOTE TODAY — A$350M NOLANS PACKAGE NEEDS SHAREHOLDER GREEN LIGHT; HANCOCK 17.5%, ENVIRONMENTAL CHALLENGE ADDS RISK (ASX:ARU)
snippet: Arafura Rare Earths Ltd. (ASX:ARU) held its Extraordinary General Meeting on July 2, 2026 to vote on the A$350 million Nolans NdPr Project funding package — a deal that requires approval of share issuances to cornerstone investors including South Korean interests alongside Hancock Prospecting's existing 17.5% stake. A yes vote would advance Nolans toward being Australia's first fully integrated rare earth mine and potentially the most significant non-Chinese NdPr supply source for U.S. and allied defence industrial applications; rejection would send the company back to the drawing board on a project already years in financing development. An environmental challenge from a Landcare group added last-minute legal risk to the proceedings. The outcome has direct implications for the broader critical minerals supply chain as Western governments accelerate efforts to reduce dependence on Chinese rare earth processing.

headline: MIDNIGHT SUN EXTENDS DUMBWA COPPER TO 6.7KM STRIKE — 260+ HOLES, 56,855m DRILLED; 0.51% CU OVER 13.7m IN LATEST RESULTS (TSXV:MMA)
snippet: Midnight Sun Mining Corp. (TSXV:MMA) reported June 29, 2026 that the Dumbwa copper deposit in Zambia's Copperbelt has now been traced to 6.7 kilometres of near-surface strike length across more than 260 holes and 56,855 metres of drilling — making it one of the most systematically drilled early-stage copper discoveries in Africa this cycle. The latest hole returned 0.51% copper over 13.7 metres at shallow depth, consistent with the oxide-dominant mineralisation style that has defined the project's open-pit economics potential. At 6.7 kilometres, Dumbwa is approaching the strike scale of world-class Zambian Copperbelt deposits, and management indicated the system remains open along strike with additional resource expansion drilling planned for H2 2026. Zambia's stable mining jurisdiction and infrastructure connectivity add to the project's development appeal at current copper prices.

headline: BRIXTON THORN OPENS 2026 CAMPAIGN WITH 14.75m @ 1.25% CU, 1.71 g/t AU, 149 g/t AG — NEAR-SURFACE GLENFIDDICH ZONE STILL OPEN (TSXV:BBB)
snippet: Brixton Metals Corp. (TSXV:BBB) released June 30, 2026 the opening results from its 2026 drill program at the Thorn Project in northwest British Columbia, with hole TN26-001 returning 14.75 metres at 1.25% copper, 1.71 g/t gold, and 149 g/t silver from the Glenfiddich Zone within the Camp Creek Corridor — a polymetallic copper-gold-silver system that remains open in multiple directions at shallow depth. The 2026 program is focused on expanding the Glenfiddich Zone footprint and testing new targets generated from last year's geophysical survey, which outlined additional chargeability anomalies along the 25-kilometre-long Camp Creek Corridor. Thorn is positioned in the same geological belt as several major BC porphyry deposits, and its multi-metal character (copper-gold-silver with molybdenum) provides commodity diversification that is attracting renewed attention as copper supply deficits build.

headline: NEWCORE ENCHI DRILLS 3.51 g/t AU OVER 21m INCLUDING 5.91 g/t OVER 9m — 99% HIT RATE IN 80,000m PROGRAM AT 1.5 MOZ GHANA RESOURCE (TSXV:NCAU)
snippet: Newcore Gold Ltd. (TSXV:NCAU) released June 30, 2026 infill and extensional drill results from the Enchi Gold Project in Ghana, with hole EDD-26-075 intersecting 3.51 g/t gold over 21.0 metres including a higher-grade core of 5.91 g/t over 9.0 metres at shallow depth within the main deposit area. Across the 80,000-metre 2026 drill program, Newcore has maintained a 99% mineralised hole success rate — a consistency metric that underpins confidence in the program's ability to expand and upgrade the current 1.5-million-ounce Indicated Mineral Resource. Ghana's Ghanaian Minerals Commission jurisdiction, permitted road access, and proximity to existing processing infrastructure at Enchi distinguish it as a development-stage project with clear permitting pathways; an updated resource estimate incorporating 2026 results is planned for H2 2026.

headline: SURGE BATTERY FILES NI 43-101 ON 10.5 MT LCE NEVADA NORTH LITHIUM RESOURCE — 657.5 MT @ 3,007 PPM LI, ONE OF THE LARGEST IN NORTH AMERICA (TSXV:NILI)
source_name: Yahoo Finance / Surge Battery Metals Inc.
snippet: Surge Battery Metals Inc. (TSXV:NILI) announced June 30, 2026 the filing of a NI 43-101 Technical Report for the Nevada North Lithium Project, formalising an Inferred Mineral Resource of 657.5 million tonnes at 3,007 parts per million lithium — equivalent to approximately 10.5 million tonnes of lithium carbonate equivalent, placing it among the largest lithium clay resources in North America by contained LCE. The resource estimate was prepared using drill data from 131 holes in the Alkali Lake Basin region of Nevada, a jurisdiction with established lithium permitting precedent from the Lithium Americas Thacker Pass project. At current GFEX lithium pricing, the project's scale and domestic U.S. location position Surge as a potential beneficiary of critical minerals supply-chain incentives under existing federal programs, notwithstanding the multi-year development timeline typical of lithium clay projects.

headline: GOLDSEEK: GOLD AT 0.898× 200-DAY MA, MOST OVERSOLD IN 3.7 YEARS — HAMILTON ARGUES RATE-HIKE SELLING WAS IRRATIONAL, Q4 RALLY IMMINENT
snippet: GoldSeek analyst Adam Hamilton's June 28, 2026 commentary argues that the current gold correction is technically overextended: at 0.898 times its 200-day moving average, gold is trading at the most oversold extreme versus its own long-term trend in 3.7 years — a level that has historically marked durable bottoms rather than the start of bear markets. Hamilton contends that the Fed rate-hike narrative driving the sell-off is irrational given that inflation is demonstrably cooling, that the gold futures market is showing its most extreme speculative short positioning since early 2024, and that gold mining stocks are priced for a sub-$3,400 gold price despite spot sitting $600 higher. His base case is a sharp Q4 2026 reversal toward new all-time highs as rate-hike expectations get repriced lower, with the current sub-$4,100 range representing one of the better entry points for sector exposure in the current bull market cycle.
